subject: DYNAMIC LENGTH clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.19.4 "The minimum length of the data item is zero. The picture symbol determines the class." OK (GR1). Three sentences, all verified: (a) length varies - dynamic_length_item golden and probe; (b) minimum zero - initial FUNCTION LENGTH of `PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH` with no VALUE is 0000 and displays [], MOVE "" gives length 0 (CobolDynString.Store never pads); (c) class from the picture symbol - StorageFormPass (1b) builds DynamicString(item.Pic.Category): a PIC N item is national (MOVE WN TO PIC X(4) refused COBOL0819 per the MOVE table; LIMIT 4 kept 4 national characters), PIC X alphanumeric. FUNCTION LENGTH of a PIC N dynamic item returns bytes (N"AB" -> 4), which is CORRECT per cite.py --check 15.50.4 "If argument-1 is a dynamic-length elementary item, the current length of argument-1 in bytes is returned." OK - not a defect. Unit cover also in CobolDynStringTests (min-zero). || Editions (adjudicator): 2014, 2023 (COBOL-2014 introduction per VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE; the 2023 Annex E lists only the 2023 SET enhancement for dynamic-length items, E.3 item 17)
